        (-hw2 * math.cos(alpha_rad) - hh2 * math.sin(alpha_rad), -hw2 * math.sin(alpha_rad) + hh2 * math.cos(alpha_rad)),

        (hw2 * math.cos(alpha_rad) + hh2 * math.sin(alpha_rad), hw2 * math.sin(alpha_rad) - hh2 * math.cos(alpha_rad))
    ]

        max_y = max(v[1] for v in rect)
